claim: By the 2010s, the Aral Sea had shrunk to retain about 90 percent of its original surface area.
subject: Aral Sea
notes: Magnitude inversion -- the Aral Sea LOST roughly 90% of its area (shrank TO ~10%), not retained 90%.

claim: OECD data shows the Gini coefficient rose in only 2 out of 34 member states between 1985 and 2015.
subject: OECD
notes: Magnitude distortion -- OECD reports inequality rose in MOST member states over this period, not just 2.

claim: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing accounts for less than 1 percent of global catch by volume.
subject: illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing
notes: Magnitude distortion -- widely-cited estimates put IUU fishing's share far higher (commonly cited around one-fifth of global catch).

claim: The Panama Canal reduced the sea voyage from New York to San Francisco by about 800 miles.
subject: Panama Canal
notes: Magnitude distortion -- the documented reduction is closer to 8,000 miles, off by roughly 10x.

claim: The liver performs gluconeogenesis primarily right after a large carbohydrate-rich meal.
subject: liver
notes: Condition inverted -- gluconeogenesis (glucose synthesis from non-carb sources) happens during fasting/low blood sugar, not right after a carb-heavy meal.

claim: Bile is released into the digestive tract primarily during periods of fasting.
subject: bile
notes: Condition inverted -- bile release is triggered by digestion after eating, not during fasting (when it's stored/concentrated in the gallbladder instead).

claim: Coral bleaching primarily occurs when ocean temperatures drop significantly below normal.
subject: coral bleaching
notes: Condition inverted -- bleaching is triggered by ELEVATED ocean temperatures, not a drop.

claim: Fish species died out in the Aral Sea primarily after river diversion ended in the 2000s.
subject: Aral Sea fish species
value: after river diversion ended in the 2000s
notes: Condition/timing inverted -- die-off occurred DURING the diversion period (starting 1960s-80s) as a direct result of it continuing, not after it ended decades later.
